title: MHA 10B Aliens
description: Replaces the Alien Evo Aliens with designs made by MariiBoops from the MHA 10B fan comic
body:
A Resource pack for Alien Evolution that replaces Ben's aliens with Deku's from the fan comic My Hero Academia 10B by Mariiboops. 

 

 

HeatBlast - Tokyo Devil

WildMutt - Bulldog

DiamondHead - Gem Krepost

XLR8 - Blue Ferrari

Grey Matter - Microchip

Four Arms - Four Might

Stinkfly - Cicada

Ripjaws - Poseidon

Upgrade - Screwloose

Ghostfreak - Eidolon
